# gitmoap_group_branch_rule (Resource)

A branch rule that every repository beneath the group inherits, unless a nearer group or the repository defines its own rule for the same pattern. It takes the same settings as a repository's rule; Maintainers of the group and above may create one, a pattern takes one rule per group, and a rule weaker than one a group above enforces for the same pattern is refused. Creating it enforced, which takes an Owner of the group, makes it a floor beneath: a nearer rule for the same pattern still applies, tightened to be at least as strict.

The token needs `branch_rule:manage` and `branch_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Protect main in every repository of the group.
resource "gitmoap_group_branch_rule" "main" {
  group_id         = gitmoap_group.platform.group_id
  branch_pattern   = "main"
  allowed_to_push  = "maintainer"
  allowed_to_merge = "developer"
  allow_force_push = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `allow_force_push` (Boolean)
- `allowed_to_merge` (String)
- `allowed_to_push` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `branch_rule_id` (String) Branch rule ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id and branch_rule_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_group_branch_rule.example "<group_id>/<branch_rule_id>"
```
